headline: TORM Responds to Hafnia Proposal to Distribute TORM Stake
summary: TORM plc acknowledged an announcement by Hafnia Limited regarding the proposed distribution of its approximately 19.8% shareholding in TORM to Hafnia shareholders.
why: TORM is a leading product tanker shipping company listed on Nasdaq, while Hafnia is a major product tanker owner and operator.

impacts.name: TORM plc
impacts.why: Hafnia proposed distributing its 19.8% shareholding in TORM to its own shareholders.
